newsitem.title: USA: DeepTech sees Q4 hurt by units' writedowns.
newsitem.headline: DeepTech sees Q4 hurt by units' writedowns.

text.p: DeepTech International Inc said Monday that it expects its fourth quarter earnings to be reduced by between $18 million and $22 million on a pre-tax basis as a result of write-downs being taken at two of its subsidiaries.
The write-downs are being taken at Tatham Offshore Inc and Leviathan Gas Pipeline Partners LP.

"The reductions at Tatham Offshore and Leviathan are of a non-recurring nature and will not impact the operational prospects of either Tatham Offshore or Leviathan," DeepTech Chairman and Chief Executive Thomas Tatham said in a statement.
The write downs at both subsidiaries are related to non-producing properities at Tatham Offshore's Ship Shoal Block 331 and Ewing Bank Block 914 2 well.
DeepTech is a diversified energy company with activities located offshore the United States in the Gulf of Mexico and offshore eastern Canada.
